questions.q: If $x$ and $y$ are two distinct integers and $n$ is a natural number then $x^{n} - y^{n}$ is divisible by
questions.solution:
$P\left(n\right): x^{n} - y^{n}$ where $n \in \mathbb{N}$

Then, $P\left(1\right): x - y$ is divisible $x - y$

$P\left(2\right): x^{2} - y^{2}$ is divisible $x - y$

$P\left(3\right): x^{3} - y^{3}$ is divisible $x - y$

Hence $x^{n} - y^{n}$ is divisible $x - y$

questions.q: If ${\left(27\right)}^{999}$ is divided by $7,$ then the remainder is
questions.solution:
Express the given number ${27}^{999}$ as ${\left(28 - 1\right)}^{999}$
Now, divide by $7,\dfrac{{( 28 - 1 )}^{999}}{7}$
and apply the formula of binomial expansion.
We get the reminder as $- 1 ⇒ 7 + ( - 1 ) = 6$
